document.name: SYNTHETIC - MV Aurora Borealis, 9-deck expedition cruise ship (planted deficiencies)

metadata.title: SYNTHETIC expedition cruise ship - test design with planted deficiencies

fire.D1_ENGINE: engine room below crew cabins: deck documented A-0, table 9.2 (12)/(6) requires A-60
fire.D3_GALLEY: main galley / main restaurant bulkhead documented B-15, table 9.1 (8)/(12) requires A-60
fire.D3_PAINT: paint locker / cabin bulkhead documented B-0, table 9.1 (6)/(14) requires A-30
fire.D1_AUXGEN: aux. generator room / aft stairway bulkhead documented A-0, table 9.1 (2)/(12) requires A-30

escape.D2_CREWCOR: crew corridor aft: single route (dead end, ~21 m)
escape.D5_BRANCH: forward corridor branch: single route (dead end, ~11.8 m)
escape.D6_SUITE6S30: suite group opening only into a pantry: no escape route
escape.D8_CINEMA: cinema opening only into an equipment store: no escape route

hazard.D1_ENGINE: engine room: one means of escape (escape trunk only)
hazard.D1_AUXGEN: aux. generator room: one route (via the deck 1 passageway)
hazard.D3_PAINT: paint locker opens only into the rope store: no escape route
hazard.D2_GAS: gas bottle store opens only into a spare-parts store: no escape route
hazard.D1_ECR: engine control room inside the machinery space: one means of escape (through the engine room)

fire_systems.D3_PAINT: paint locker: no fixed fire-extinguishing system documented (SOLAS II-2 10.6.3.1)
fire_systems.D1_FOT_S: MGO tank 1 (S): 0.76 m from the side shell (MARPOL I/12A requires at least 1.0 m)
